# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest code on the `main` branch. Tagged
releases are supported while they remain the current release line.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | :white_check_mark: |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.**

Report vulnerabilities privately using one of these channels:

1. **[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/semirturgay/ai-career-os/security/advisories/new)** (preferred)
2. Email [semir.turgay@gmail.com](mailto:semir.turgay@gmail.com) with subject
   `AI Career OS security`

Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, affected components, and
your environment (commit or version) when relevant.

You should receive an acknowledgment within **72 hours**. If the report is
accepted, we will work with you on a fix and coordinated disclosure timeline.
If declined, we will explain why (for example, out of scope or not reproducible).

**Out of scope:** social engineering, issues in third-party LLM providers without
a demonstrable exploit path in this app, and denial-of-service against a local
dev instance without broader impact.

**Safe harbor:** We appreciate responsible disclosure and will not pursue legal
action against researchers who report issues in good faith and follow this
policy.
